itens.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / AI Solutions Engineer
itens.description:
Responsible for designing and integrating full-stack systems for national and international medical societies, using Node.js, Vue.js, and cloud services.
  • Developed a medical E-learning platform (Vue.js/Vuex) with detailed watch-time tracking and analytics to boost learning engagement.
  • Created the World Kidney Day platform, connecting hospitals nationwide to promote preventive health campaigns.
  • Built a geolocation-based specialist search tool, ensuring accurate proximity results for medical professionals.
  • Implemented an annual fee and subscription management system, integrating with Mercado Pago for automated billing and improved financial performance.
  • Currently implementing AI integrations and automations to optimize internal processes and user interactions.
Projects consistently delivered measurable impact, improving system scalability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
